OLED_INIT: init oled width %1 height %2 I2C address %3
OLED_INIT_WITH_PINS: init oled width %1 height %2 I2C address %3 SDA %4 SCL %5
OLED_INIT_TOOLTIP: Arduino Nano uses software I2C on the selected SDA and SCL pins. Other boards keep their original I2C library behavior.
OLED_DRAWLINE: oled draw line x0: %1 y0: %2, x1: %3 y1：%4 color %5
OLED_DRAWRECT: oled draw rect x: %1 y: %2 width %3 height %4 color %5
OLED_FILLRECT: oled fill rect x: %1 y: %2 width %3 height %4 color %5
OLED_DRAWCIRCLE: oled draw circle x: %1 y: %2 radius %3 color %4
OLED_FILLCIRCLE: oled fill circle x: %1 y: %2 radius %3 color %4
OLED_DRAWROUNDRECT: oled draw round rect x: %1 y: %2 width %3 height %4 radius %5 color %6
OLED_FILLROUNDRECT: oled fill round rect x: %1 y: %2 width %3 height %4 radius %5 color %6
OLED_DRAWTRIANGLE: oled draw triangle x0: %1 y0: %2, x1: %3 y1: %4, x2: %5 y2: %6 color %7
OLED_FILLTRIANGLE: oled fill triangle x0: %1 y0: %2, x1: %3 y1: %4, x2: %5 y2: %6 color %7
OLED_SETTEXT: set oled text size %1 color %2 background color %3
INIT_GUARD_TUBIT_REQUIRED: Place the "TUBIT initialization" block under the "when Arduino starts" block.
INIT_GUARD_SENSOR_REQUIRED: Place the "%1 %2 initialization" block under "when Arduino starts", before any blocks that read or use the module.
INIT_GUARD_INIT_PLACEMENT: Place the "%1 %2 initialization" block directly under "when Arduino starts", before loops or conditions.
INIT_GUARD_OLED_REQUIRED: First add an OLED display block and put the drawing blocks inside it, or place a clear/update display block before them.
INIT_GUARD_INVALID_ID: Enter a non-negative whole-number module ID.
